_comment: Track B (open-model MT) per-language confidence. Not a runtime file. tier: CERTIFIED|CERTIFIED_FLAGGED|EXPERIMENTAL. Verified by a SINGLE Llama-3.1-405B judge (langid-gate + meaning fidelity). careful_fidelity_pct = post-fan-out judge-clean fraction over re-verified leaves (>=20 leaves); langs with tiny re-samples retain prior value. Re-tier bar = 85%. hat/awa/kea retained despite sub-85 (langid/close-relative false-positives, 0 confirmed meaning bugs). A FULL two-model (llama405+qwen72) improvement pass is planned next.
